questions.title: What can you ask your friend when you can't see the flag?
questions.question: You are in a bunker and can't see the flag. Which of these questions are you allowed to ask your friend without breaking the rules?

choices.text: Is this the best club to use?
How should I hit this shot?
Should I aim to the left or the right?

questions.explanation: You can ask where the flag is, but you aren't allowed to ask for tips about which club to use, how to hit, or where to aim.

vocabulary.simpleMeaning: A bunker is a sandy area, sometimes called a sand trap, on the golf course.
The flag shows where the hole is on the green.

questions.teachingTip: Tell children it's helpful to know where things are, but they should solve the rest themselves during a round.
likelyMisconceptions: Children might think it's OK to ask for coaching or tips during play.
Some might think all questions are allowed as long as they don't touch the ball.

questions.title: Allowed questions in golf
questions.question: If you can't see the flag from a bunker, which of these questions can you ask a friend without breaking the rules?

choices.text: Is this the right club for the shot?
How should I play this shot?
Should I aim left or right?

questions.explanation: You are allowed to ask about distance or the location of the flag, but you cannot ask for advice about clubs, tactics, or where to aim.
